description: Convert a 3-byte UDS DTC to the SAE J2012 style code (P/C/B/U + digits) plus failure type byte, or the reverse ("U0073-00" to hex). With a status byte, explains each of the 8 DTC status bits.

dtc.description: Three bytes hex ("01 23 45") or a code ("P0123-45").
